verdict.rationale: Ramp MCP is documented to let users "query Ramp data and take actions with natural language" from assistants like ChatGPT and Claude. Support docs give example commands such as "Lock my card — I can't find it" and "Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter". The AI Agents guide documents natural-language reads, approvals, edits, policy Q&A and purchases, and a probe confirms the OAuth-gated MCP server is live with granular read/write scopes. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command surface (natural language runs through third-party assistants), bill approvals via MCP (documented as not yet available), and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language actions working end-to-end.
